about.title: About
about.lead: I write code that removes work rather than adding it.
about.bio: I graduated in Computer Science from Université Ferhat Abbas — Sétif 1, specialising in software engineering. Since then I've worked at the seam between operations and engineering: the place where a business runs on spreadsheets, copy-paste and hope, and someone needs to replace that with something that actually holds. My work spans automation pipelines, e-commerce integrations, and the web applications that sit on top of them.

ranli.summary: Designed and shipped custom automation connecting Shopify, Ecomanager and Google Sheets. Rebuilt the ETL layer so data moves without a human in the loop.
highlights: Cut manual data-handling errors by 90% by replacing copy-paste workflows with scripted, validated pipelines
Built bidirectional sync between Shopify orders and internal Sheets-based inventory using the Apps Script runtime and webhooks
Owned live incident response for operational workflows

etl-shopify-sync.title: Shopify ↔ Sheets ETL pipeline
etl-shopify-sync.problem: Order, stock and fulfilment data lived in three systems that didn't talk. Staff reconciled them by hand every day, and the errors compounded downstream into wrong stock counts and missed shipments.
etl-shopify-sync.solution: Built a scheduled and webhook-triggered pipeline in Google Apps Script that extracts from the Shopify Admin API and Ecomanager, validates and normalises every record against a strict schema, then loads into the Sheets-based operational store. Bad records are quarantined and reported instead of silently written.
etl-shopify-sync.outcome: Manual handling errors dropped by 90%, roughly fifteen hours a week of reconciliation disappeared, and stock figures became trustworthy enough to make decisions on.

gotrek.title: GoTrek — tourism guidance app
gotrek.problem: Travellers exploring the region had no single, reliable source for routes, timing and local orientation data — the information was scattered across forums and out of date.
gotrek.solution: Architected and built a mobile application over a REST backend, with a normalised PostgreSQL schema for routes and points of interest, offline-capable caching, and a UI designed in Figma around one-handed use outdoors.
gotrek.outcome: A working guidance app covering forty-plus curated routes with a sub-1.2-second cold start on mid-range hardware.

data-integrity-audit.title: Data integrity audit & automated reporting
data-integrity-audit.problem: A business ran its software tracking on spreadsheets nobody trusted. Duplicate rows, inconsistent formats and silent overwrites meant every report needed manual verification before anyone would act on it.
data-integrity-audit.solution: Audited the existing model, designed a validated schema with typed columns and referential checks, and wrote automation that runs conformity rules on every write. Violations trigger an alert with the offending row rather than failing quietly.
data-integrity-audit.outcome: Over thirty thousand records audited and normalised, and reporting that used to take a manual weekly pass now lands in near real time.

n8n-lead-router.title: n8n lead routing & notification system
n8n-lead-router.problem: Inbound enquiries arrived by email and sat unread for hours. There was no triage, no deduplication, and no record of what happened to a lead after it arrived.
n8n-lead-router.solution: Built an n8n workflow that receives a signed webhook, validates the payload, deduplicates against previous submissions, writes an audit row to Supabase, and fans out an instant Telegram notification plus a templated acknowledgement email.
n8n-lead-router.outcome: Median response time fell from hours to under thirty seconds, with a durable audit trail for every enquiry.

cv-ai-agent.title: Grounded multilingual CV agent
cv-ai-agent.problem: Recruiters ask the same dozen questions and rarely read past the first screen of a CV. A generic chatbot would answer them — and would also confidently invent qualifications, which is worse than saying nothing.
cv-ai-agent.solution: Built a streaming agent on the Vercel AI SDK whose entire knowledge base is generated from a single typed profile file. The system prompt forbids extrapolation, names the exact degree level to prevent inflation, and gives the model an explicit fallback so it always has a compliant move when it doesn't know.
cv-ai-agent.outcome: Answers in four languages, streams the first token in around 400 ms, and cannot claim a credential that isn't in the source file.

campaign-analytics.title: Cross-market campaign analytics
campaign-analytics.problem: Campaigns ran across three markets with no shared view of what conversion actually cost, so budget decisions were made on gut feel.
campaign-analytics.solution: Instrumented campaigns against the Snapchat Marketing API, built a consistent conversion-metric definition across markets, and wired CRM automation so qualified contacts were followed up without manual handoff.
campaign-analytics.outcome: A comparable view across three markets and a materially lower cost per acquisition once spend followed the data.
